# FLX-3611: consumers limits are malformed or past their bounds

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

limits.seconds is a whole number from 1 to 600 (30 when absent) and limits.memory is a size such as 512MiB or 1GiB of at most 16GiB (1GiB when absent).

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3611
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
